description: Update an existing log export configuration before or between export runs. Only workspace_id, time_of_generation_max, and requested_fields can change after creation, so use get_log_export to review the current job and start_log_export after the definition is ready. Enterprise-gated. Returns 403 on non-Enterprise Portkey plans.

export_id.description: The unique ID of the log export to update

requested_fields.description: Fields to include in export: id, trace_id, created_at, request, response, is_success, ai_org, ai_model, req_units, res_units, total_units, request_url, cost, cost_currency, response_time, response_status_code, mode, config, prompt_slug, metadata

time_of_generation_max.description: Maximum time filter in date format (e.g., '2024-07-25' or ISO 8601)

name: update_log_export

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
